stage: resumable ordered zoned occurrence queries with independent segment/month/rule-year budgets
behavior: Init copies expression/bounds and records zone identity, rounds the UTC start and calculates the periodic suffix limit without traversing segments/calendar months/rule years.

Each Step uses independent positive segment-start, calendar-month and next-transition-rule-year budgets. Each cumulative counter delta is bounded by its budget; the transition loop yields inside the403-year fallback.
Segments include capped logarithmic history-directory lookup, fixed five-year state lookup and one ready-match check. This constant overhead is distinct from charged next-transition rule years.

Ordered actual-instant semantics retain all folds, skip absent labels, complete history before suffix periodicity and report unknown coverage before an unproven earliest result. PENDING/NONE/ERROR preserve Next; FOUND alone publishes it.

Cursor is address bound and borrows the exact live immutable zone supplied to Init and every Step. No implicit retain or Unit; caller holds the owner across all uses/handoffs. Expression input may change after Init.

Structural spans/aliases protect cursor, expression at Init, outputs and all zone/footer storage. Value issues survive diagnostic OOM; argument/state failures preserve progress. Terminal results/counters repeat without traversal.
costs: 512 caller bytes; private typed value416 plus wrapper identity metadata. Init copies expression/dates, initializes private state and writes the context, clearing only its unused tail.

Public Step uses memcpy to decode/encode private state (at most512 bytes each way), owned-span/identity/budget checks and optional32-byte issue publication. No heap, retention, lock, timer, worker, callback or new runtime/dependency.
A month uses bounded bitmap/date work; a charged rule year checks two rule events and bounded state lookup. No elapsed CPU, OS scheduling or zero-overhead claim.

Specialized synchronous loops and resumable loops share bitmap/event/tie rules. Control-flow duplication is explicit; independent oracles and private/public parity constrain it. The typed engine avoids opaque public wrapper copies for later kernel integration.
tests: Existing golden fold/gap/negative/half-hour/triple-fold cases,160 brute windows and1000 full-int64 UTC specialization cases also execute varied cursor budgets.
A complete400-year always-gap absence and500 years of history before the first2500 footer occurrence complete across yields; no global Begin+400 cutoff.

600 private transition comparisons against specialized synchronous traversal include endpoints, leap-only/zero-delta/extreme-time rules. An exclusively owned synthetic general-engine fixture retains the exact403 actual one-year fallback turns normally pruned by the factory.
A real leap-only rule across2100 requires at least8 separately charged rule years even for a narrow query;1024 full cursor resets preserve ambient error and requested-allocation counters.

Expression snapshot, zone identity/no hidden retain, copied contexts, every zero budget, output/zone/footer aliases, wrapped spans, failed reset atomicity, repeated terminals and explicit-owner serialized thread handoff.
Unknown prefix and unknown boundary after a known segment, including cached typed mapping failure under diagnostic OOM; typed expression/state OOM failures preserve context.
Native single fixture runs the same tests; external static/shared consumers execute both new symbols; the offline example prints5 turns,2 segments,2 months,5 rule years for the later fold.
